notes.localization: Social uses Flarum's native localization. The forum language selector switches both the forum and Social between the bundled Turkish and English translations.
notes.s3: S3 mode needs league/flysystem-aws-s3-v3 and aws/aws-sdk-php. Media stays access-controlled through the API; the public URL setting is optional for CDN fronting only.
notes.realtime: Realtime is optional. Choose Pusher to reuse the existing flarum/pusher app, or Centrifugo with its own server. Without either, chat falls back to periodic refresh.

cleanup.title: Media cleanup
cleanup.text: Runs the same safe cleanup used by the scheduled command. Media still referenced by a post, comment, message, story or profile is never removed.
cleanup.confirm: Run cleanup now? Unreferenced files will be deleted.
